_comment: This file is a generic template. The live system never reads it directly. On first install, install.ps1 copies this template to the install dir as config/sources.json (only if not already present). For local development, copy this file to config/sources.json (which is gitignored) and edit. The IndexBuilder reads the path you pass it on the command line.
_format: Each entry has either { id, path, exclude_subfolders? } for static indexing or { id, discover: { root, directory_name, max_depth } } for walking a tree and indexing every directory matching directory_name.
